definitions.explanation: A type of high-altitude, thin, wispy cloud formed at very high altitudes. One of the ten basic cloud types in meteorology.

examples.japanese: ⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{巻雲|けんうん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっている→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: Cirrus clouds are spreading across the sky.

examples.japanese: {巻雲|けんうん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{崩|くず}れる→崩れる：04248_kuzureru⟧⟦{前兆|ぜんちょう}→前兆：09118_zenchou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Cirrus clouds are considered a sign that the weather is about to worsen.

examples.japanese: {巻雲|けんうん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{氷|こおり}→氷：02753_koori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結晶|けっしょう}→結晶：13798_kesshou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦できて→できる：00557_dekiru⟧おり、⟦{高度|こうど}→高度：00243_koudo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦ところ→所：01137_tokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧。
examples.english: Cirrus clouds are made of ice crystals and form at very high altitudes.

notes:
A compound of {巻|けん} (curl, roll) and {雲|うん} (cloud). The formal meteorological term for cirrus clouds, which are thin, feathery clouds found at high altitudes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {巻雲|けんうん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: cirrus clouds appear
- {巻雲|けんうん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧: cirrus clouds spread

OTHER CLOUD TYPES:
- ⟦{積雲|せきうん}→積雲：23702_sekiun⟧: cumulus cloud
- ⟦{層雲|そううん}→層雲：23703_souun⟧: stratus cloud
- {乱雲|らんうん}: nimbus cloud
- ⟦{巻積雲|けんせきうん}→巻積雲：29517_kensekiun⟧: cirrocumulus (mackerel sky)

USAGE:
In everyday language, cirrus clouds are often called すじ{雲|ぐも} (streak clouds) due to their wispy, hair-like appearance. {巻雲|けんうん} is the more technical/scientific term.
